proposals.evidence: Turner gives Punjabi buhārā/bahārī and Prakrit baühārī/bōhārī broom under bahukāra. Kullu buārə matches the neighboring whole broom formation with loss of intervocalic h; the link leaves local Punjabi contact open. Other broom responses lacking enough consonantal material to distinguish bahukāra from vardhana are excluded.
